units.source_text: 且说源氏公子自念久不赴左大臣邸，

en.t: Now Prince Genji reflected that he had not visited the Minister of the Left's residence for a long time,

units.source_text: 但又可怜那个幼小的紫姬，

en.t: but he also felt sorry for the young Lady Murasaki,
so he decided to go and comfort her first,

units.source_text: 便走出宫邸，回二条院去。

en.t: and then he left the palace residence and returned to Nijo-in.
